title: How I started the new year:
excerpt: enjoying conversation by phone with some young afghan peace volunteers … May God help us, this year, be agents of true peace: in our families, in our communities, in our world. Stay tuned for more opportunities like this one, friends (without borders). Happy New Year, everyone!
body:
enjoying conversation by phone with some young afghan peace volunteers … May God help us, this year, be agents of true peace: in our families, in our communities, in our world.

Stay tuned for more opportunities like this one, friends (without borders).

Happy New Year, everyone!
